name: Global Policing Database

summaryMethod: AI-drafted from the linked official pages; factual signposting description, not an evidence appraisal.

summaryMethod: AI-drafted from the linked official pages; factual signposting description, not an evidence appraisal.

name: Center for Problem-Oriented Policing
about: Guides, tools and case studies for problem-oriented policing, covering specific crime problems, local analysis, practical responses and examples of implementation.
summaryMethod: AI-drafted from the linked official pages; factual signposting description, not an evidence appraisal.
sourceNotes: Uses its parent institution ASU’s official logo, also used by the POP site. Core resources are English; selected publications have the listed translations, including Simplified and Traditional Chinese. This does not imply the complete collection is available in every language.
